image_description: A live concert performance scene featuring three musicians on an elevated stage. The central figure is a male guitarist wearing a cap and playing an electric guitar. To the right, two female vocalists stand at microphones. The stage floor appears to be wooden planking with red risers or monitors. In the foreground, large black speaker cabinets are visible. The background features complex stage lighting rigs with blue and red beams cutting through atmospheric haze/smoke.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The musicians are clearly standing on a surface higher than the implied audience level (foreground speakers), and the edge of the platform is visible near the bottom center.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The floor under the musicians shows wood grain texture and plank lines, consistent with a wooden stage deck, though lit by colored lights.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The fingers on the fretboard appear slightly fused and lack distinct separation, a common AI artifact in fine motor tasks. The guitar headstock geometry is also slightly ambiguous.
The bases and poles of the microphone stands blend into the floor and each other. The connection points between the stand legs and the vertical pole are indistinct and physically implausible.
The straight lines of the speaker box show slight warping and softness, lacking the rigid geometric precision expected of manufactured hardware.
Slight bleeding between the dark clothing of the rightmost vocalist and the background/hair, reducing edge sharpness.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the scene is correctly classified as a 'stage' and not just a generic concert photo, verifying architectural elements.
To verify the physical separation between the elevated stage and the foreground, and ensure lighting rigs are structurally anchored above.
To detect fusion artifacts in thin, high-contrast objects like mic stands and guitar necks which often fail in AI generation.
To assess the impact of lighting haze on structural clarity and identify any global texture inconsistencies.

focus_areas: Structural integrity of thin objects (mic stands, guitar necks)
Geometric consistency of the stage elevation (foreground vs background depth)
Anatomical correctness of musicians' hands interacting with instruments
Edge sharpness between stage floor and supporting structures
